### 2026-11-04: ![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/Sg2YTK32CyhyRAQxm5AUnJ98fO1aU3hg/0c81d938c708ac85698d41db998b25b89861ac71f427fa9199ead66dcb22ebc7.png)

Made a fair amount of progress in making my 1st custom esp32 dev board
Things completed today:
- ESP32 chip and pin connections
- UART and USB Type C connections
- PSU

Things still pending:
- ERC checks
- assigning footprints and annotating schematics
- PCB and routes
- assigning footprints
- some extra stuff (a tb6612 FNG motor driver, few RGB leds (WS28212B) and an SD card slot)

### 2026-11-07: Completed the schematic, took longer than expected, mostly becuase I was too afraid to even start routing the PCB for the CP2102N might be incorrectly connected

**4h**

Completed the schematic, took longer than expected, mostly becuase I was too afraid to even start routing the PCB for the CP2102N might be incorrectly connected
Things I did:
- Verified all ERC checks
- Sourced all components (for many of them, they have a large min order quantity, something I cant chose)
- fixed AMS1117 5v to 3.3v (it was an accident)
- Added USB Surge proctection, few more decoupling caps and auto programming circuit
- Added Custom modules: 12 WS2812B RGB LEDs, 4 push buttons, 1 rotary encoder

Now I will start with teh PCB routing part

### 2026-11-07: Took a little longer than expeted, SMD routing is harder than THT routing, for you cant start a via on 1 layer and end it on another, not my fault

**3.03h**

Took a little longer than expeted, SMD routing is harder than THT routing, for you cant start a via on 1 layer and end it on another, not my fault

Things I did:
- assigned footprints and sourced all components
- routed a lot of the PCB
